title: Hitta tjänster och ansöka
request: New-arrival information challenge: WHICH services,WHERE apply,HOW use; source OFTEN,no real person assigned disability/immigration status.

title: Tillstånd och hemkommun
request: Residence permit AND Finnish municipality of residence -> source right to services,including examples disability services; no unconditional permit-only eligibility.

title: Klientplan med socialvården
request: Newly arrived person with disability MAY prepare client plan WITH welfare-region social care; anonymous persons/document,no actual protected status claim.

title: Stöd och tjänster i planen
request: Neutral actual blank planning notebook/document object,not fabricated completed official client plan or real personal record.

title: Lika rätt till integration
request: Equal integration rights plus source EXAMPLES language teaching,education,employment; distinct three branches,no automatic job guarantee.

title: De flesta tjänster
request: Verified Finnish public social/health institution,source MOST services for ALL region residents; not a particular eligibility decision or all-services guarantee.

title: Särskilda tjänster
request: Welfare-region obligation to offer disability-specific services,not a guarantee each applicant receives every named service.

title: Delaktighet och vardag
request: Actual accessible public environment illustrating participation,dignified context,no pictured person diagnosed or individual accessibility guarantee.

title: Också en del långtidssjuka
request: SOME services also for chronic illness IF daily-activity difficulty OR work-capacity problems DUE TO illness; preserve both limitations.

title: Exempel på långvariga sjukdomar
request: Five exact source examples diabetes,epilepsy,asthma,rheumatism,osteoarthritis MAY reduce function; no diagnosis,anatomy,treatment or universal incapacity.

title: Färdtjänst: två behov
request: Disability plus cannot use public transit OR needs help outside home; source OR not AND,no pictured passenger assigned eligibility.

title: Personlig hjälp i vardagen
request: MAY receive help with daily tasks unable to do independently DUE TO disability OR illness; no all-activities guarantee.

title: Exempel på assistans
request: Actual shopping/cooking/study objects as varied collage,not photographed person labelled assistant/client; source examples include work,mobility,study.

title: Assistentens lön
request: Welfare-region institution -> assistant salary,distinct from cash paid to service user; no invented wage or employer arrangement.

title: Serviceboende och stött boende
request: Verified actual accessible/supported housing exterior if identity licensed,otherwise neutral home object; preserve two source housing categories,no institution substitution.

title: Egna boendekostnader
request: Resident -> own housing costs; distinguish from following free special support,no invented rent or universal all-care fee.

title: Särskilt stöd avgiftsfritt
request: Special services/support helping daily HOME tasks -> no service charge; do not label housing/rent itself free.

title: Hjälpmedel efter behov
request: Actual assistive-device object,region arranges needed aids; no brand endorsement or assumed universal device choice.

title: Rullstol, hörapparat och synstöd
request: Accurately identified actual wheelchair/hearing aid/white cane/guide dog objects as source EXAMPLES,not ordinary pet as guide dog or patient diagnosis.

title: Hjälpmedel avgiftsfria
request: Assistive-device source examples linked to no fee,not every conceivable retail purchase reimbursement.

title: Parkeringstillstånd
request: Source severe-disability qualification and MAY get mobility parking permit; anonymous schematic card,not real identity or counterfeit-ready permit.

title: Rullstolsmärkt plats
request: Actual Finnish accessible parking sign/marked bay; permit-car condition explicit,no claim photographed car has or lacks permit.

title: Nära ingången
request: Distinct verified marked accessible parking near building entrance; no allegation of misuse or invented distance.

title: Tolkning för olika ärenden
request: Hearing OR combined sight/hearing OR speech impairment -> MAY get interpreting for work,study,hobbies,errands; not ordinary foreign-language translation eligibility.

title: Ansök hos FPA
request: Verified actual Kela/FPA building or neutral application object,not invented interface or eligibility result.

title: Hemkommunens undervisningstolk
request: Home municipality -> interpreting for early-childhood,preschool,basic education; preserve all three categories,not FPA branch.

title: Gratis om rätt beviljats
request: IF RIGHT TO disability interpreting GRANTED -> use free; explicit gate,not every interpreter booking free.

title: Beställ tolken själv
request: Actual ordinary telephone/calendar object illustrating user booking,not invented service number,current procedure or automatic assignment.

title: Rehabilitering kan ges
request: Severe disability OR severe illness -> MAY rehabilitation; no automatic entitlement to every therapy.

title: Barn och vuxna
request: BOTH children AND adults as source rehabilitation groups,no invented age threshold here.

title: Även familjer
request: Rehabilitation offered to disabled persons AND families,not only individual/no guaranteed whole-family programme.

title: Ledd verksamhet och exempel
request: Professionally led course/physiotherapy/psychotherapy/speech therapy/occupational therapy as EXAMPLES; distinct appropriate objects,no treatment instructions or anatomical claims.

title: Tolk på kursen
request: POSSIBLE interpreter for rehabilitation courses,not guaranteed immediate language coverage.

title: Arbete och självständig vardag
request: Distinct actual accessible work/everyday environment showing rehabilitation GOAL,no promised cure or assigned disability status.

title: EU:s funktionshinderkort
request: CAN APPLY for EU disability card in Finland; clearly schematic anonymous card,not automatic issuance or counterfeit-ready document.

title: Permanent eller långvarig
request: Card source qualification permanent disability OR long-term illness; preserve OR,no invented severity threshold or application outcome.

title: Kultur, motion och besöksmål
request: Actual cultural/sports visitor setting as source use EXAMPLES in Finland and SEVERAL other EU countries; no all-EU acceptance map.

title: Visa behov av tillgänglighet
request: Actual accessible route/ramp object,card communicates need for help/accessible path/assistant; no claim it guarantees every venue adaptation.

title: A-märkning och gratis följe
request: MANY places plus card SHOWN AND marked A -> assistant OR interpreter enters free; not universal admission or free cardholder ticket.

title: Organisationer bevakar intressen
request: Verified actual disability/patient organisation setting if licensed or neutral meeting objects,no logo-only substitute or real member diagnosis.

title: Påverka genom organisationer
request: Member voices -> organisation -> society/disabled persons position; possible influence,no guaranteed policy result.

title: Ändring eller fast hjälpmedel
request: IF necessary home modification OR fixed assistive installation -> MAY compensation; no amount or universal approval.

title: Rullstol i bostaden
request: Actual accessible domestic doorway/ramp object,source EXAMPLE adaptation,no invented width,technical specification or site guarantee.

title: Fasta hjälpmedel: exempel
request: Accurately identified actual lift/visual-signal doorbell or smoke alarm objects; light REPLACES sound for hearing impairment,not ordinary bulb/doorbell substitution.

title: Bedömning tillsammans
request: Regional disability-service social worker WITH user assesses NEED for modifications; not unilateral automatic approval.

title: Om kollektivtrafik inte fungerar
request: IF disability causes inability to use public transport -> MAY transport-service right; explicit causation/possibility,not all disabled persons cannot use transit.

title: Ledsagare vid behov
request: IF NEEDED companion assists travel,MAY accompany; no universal mandatory escort or real person assigned role.

title: Arbete, studier och fritid
request: Actual transport vehicle/stop objects with three source trip purposes,no invented route,availability or journey count.

title: Ansökan i ditt område
request: Application -> own area disability service,not FPA or automatic booking; no fabricated contact details.

title: Högst kollektivtrafikens taxa
request: Transport-service user cost <= public-transport fare,qualitative comparison,no invented euro amount or claim all travel free.

title: Under 65 och svårt behov
request: (Severe disability OR illness) AND UNDER65 -> FPA MAY demanding medical rehabilitation AND reimburse PART of cost; no full-cost guarantee or <=65error.

title: Stora svårigheter i vardagen
request: Disability OR illness CAUSES major difficulty at home OR work OR school -> MAY rehabilitation; not minor difficulty universal approval.

title: Anstalt eller bo hemma
request: Medical rehabilitation in institution OR live at home and attend visits; distinguish residence from compulsory inpatient care.

title: Klara vardagen bättre
request: Distinct daily-life assistive object illustrating GOAL of improved coping,no cure/outcome guarantee.

title: Också barn
request: Children WITH severe disability MAY demanding medical rehabilitation; no invented lower age or automatic programme.

title: Rehabiliteringsplan behövs
request: Actual anonymous blank plan/notebook object,clearly not real official completed document or personal medical record.

title: Vem du kontaktar
request: Contact own social/health centre OR occupational-health doctor; no invented referral result/phone number.

title: Familjevård utanför eget hem
request: Neutral private-home exterior illustrating SOURCE family-care definition outside own home,no photographed household assigned care status.

title: Familjehem vid vårdbehov
request: Intellectual disability AND care need -> MAY live in family home; no conflation with all disabilities or institutional compulsion.

title: Även tillfälligt
request: Family home with temporary calendar cue,no invented maximum/minimum duration.

title: Också i eget hem
request: Family care MAY ALSO be arranged in care recipient own home,explicit alternative to prior outside-home definition.

title: Kontinuerligt behov och inget hemalternativ
request: Intellectual disability AND continuous care need AND cannot get care at home OR service housing -> MAY institution; explicitly neither suitable home option available,not an automatic institutional destination.

title: Korta tider på anstalt
request: Institution MAY short stays,unnumbered calendar,no invented mandatory duration.

title: Arbets- och dagverksamhet
request: Actual neutral activity/workshop objects for region-arranged work/day activities,no photographed person labelled disabled or unsupported salary claim.

title: Lätt arbete
request: Distinct actual light craft/work object showing source light-work category,no unsafe machinery or employment/wage implication.

title: Dagverksamhetens målgrupp
request: Severe disability AND unable to participate in work activities -> source day-activity group,no conflation with unemployment.

title: Exempel på dagverksamhet
request: Actual cooking/exercise/conversation/outdoor objects as useful varied collage,source MAY and EXAMPLES,no guaranteed timetable or pictured participant diagnosis.
